title: Talk about your day
description: Repeat routine phrases, then describe your day.

items.targetText: I wake up at seven every day.
I go to work by bus.

items.prompt: What time do you wake up? Answer in English.
items.promptIt: A che ora ti svegli? Rispondi in inglese.

items.prompt: Say two things you do every day.
items.promptIt: Di' due cose che fai ogni giorno.
items.exampleAnswer: I go to work. I study English.
